promotion.title: Limited-Time Student Support Promotion
promotion.message:
Through September 30, MelodyGen is offering free access to support students preparing for college applications, music auditions, and new learning goals.

During this period, MelodyGen Pro is available free of charge to all users.

For existing subscribers, the next billing date will be extended by one month.

We hope each day of ear training builds your confidence. We are cheering for your next step.
